references.text: The introduction to the description of the lampstand, which this verse continues to elaborate on with details about the six branches.
Continuation of the description of the lampstand's branches with details about the bowls, knobs, and flowers on each branch.
Description of the actual construction of the lampstand with the six branches extending from the sides, as commanded.
Reference to the design of the lampstand when it was set up in the tabernacle.
Solomon's temple had ten golden lampstands, designed according to the pattern of the tabernacle's lampstand.
Zechariah's vision of a golden lampstand with seven lamps, building on the image from the tabernacle's lampstand.
John's vision of seven golden lampstands, symbolically connected to the lampstand in the tabernacle.
Explanation of the seven lampstands as the seven churches, with symbolism drawn from the tabernacle's lampstand.
Specifies the details of the same six branches described in the source verse.
Describes the decoration on the same six branches and confirms a unified design.
